source_changes: GraphSample and GraphBatch carry optional receiver/sender edge_index
collation validates range, uniqueness and self coverage, offsets, concatenates and device-transfers supplied edges
validated GraphBatch and synthetic benchmark edges use an explicit metadata-only model fast path
direct model callers retain full edge-content validation by default
QM9 can precompute 2.5-Angstrom radius candidates once at load time
training and evaluation forward exact supplied edges
the private EGNN control accepts the same optional sparse edge API
each active EC local stage owns a 12-wide invariant edge MLP and equivariant sum branches
inference_boundary: The O(E_local + N) claim begins after edge contents are validated. The load-time radius scan and duplicate/self validation are excluded from the linear model-execution claim.
